Class AccountService

java.lang.Object
lms.application.AccountService
public class AccountService extends Object
Application service for managing user financial accounts in the Library Management System.

This service coordinates account-related operations including fine management, account status tracking, and borrowing eligibility checks. It acts as a bridge between the presentation layer and the domain layer's Account entity.

Key responsibilities:

  • Manage user fines (add, pay, calculate totals)
  • Control account status (suspend, activate)
  • Check borrowing eligibility based on account status
  • Provide aggregated financial statistics
